title: PAGEWIND — Offline reading and listening, with a deliberate handover, 24 deliverables

# PAGEWIND — product facts

## Identity and interface
- Product name: PAGEWIND.
- Brand accent: #1F4E5F.
- Supporting colours, typography, icons and component geometry: open design choices.
- Night background: #18252B.
- Night action colour: a lighter related accent where appropriate for contrast.
- Main-area navigation order: Library, Downloads, Settings.
- Reader, Player, overlays, mode-switch and continue-choice navigation: return action.
- Non-empty Library and Downloads book identification: The Small Lantern; The Empty Bench; author PAGEWIND Studio.
- The Small Lantern catalog artwork: lantern-cover-art.png.
- Interface language: English.
- Handover action labels: Listen; Read; Confirm.
- Saved-text action label: Open saved text.
- Timer-expired action label: Resume.
- Status vocabulary: selected, disabled, playing, paused, pending; colour accompanied by text or symbols.
- Body-text contrast target: at least 4.5:1.
- Large-text and meaningful-icon contrast target: at least 3:1.
- Required copy and controls: fully visible within the appropriate safe areas.

## Books and source records
- 03-books.md: two complete mini-book records.
- LANTERN: The Small Lantern; author PAGEWIND Studio; 2 chapters; total narration 03:00.
- L1: A light in the window; 6 sentences; nominal audio duration 90 seconds / 01:30.
- L2: The walk home; 6 sentences; nominal audio duration 90 seconds / 01:30.
- BENCH: The Empty Bench; author PAGEWIND Studio; 1 chapter; narration availability: not offered.
- B1: Waiting; 6 sentences; audio timeline cells: empty, meaning narration not offered.
- 04-chapter-text-and-timeline.md: complete original chapter wording and all sentence intervals.
- 05-state-snapshots.md: named screen examples with connection, device, text anchor, chapter-relative audio position, playback, availability and save/sync status.
- Texts, records and timing assignments: original author-owned inputs, distributable with the commission.
- Content completeness: all 6 sentences of each chapter supplied.
- Interface location wording: sentence IDs or equivalent Chapter 1, sentence 3 wording.
- Chapter and book titles: exact source spelling.
- Short explanatory interface copy: open wording within the supplied behaviour.

## Position mapping
- Text location: chapter plus sentence ID, independent of pagination, text size and viewport width.
- Audio interval convention: inclusive start, exclusive end.
- Read to Listen target: start of the current sentence, previewed before explicit confirmation.
- Listen to Read result: paused playback and the sentence containing the current chapter-relative offset.
- L1 00:37: L1-S03; sentence start 00:30.
- L1 00:45: L1-S04.
- Exact chapter-end state: last sentence completed; next chapter offered as an explicit action.
- Playback-speed changes: retained media offset and nominal track duration.
- Text progress representation: chapter and sentence anchor.
- switch-to-audio: proposed target 00:30; stored audio offset 00:37 until confirmation.
- offline-unavailable: proposed L2-S02 sentence-start target 00:15; retained Phone A record L2-S02 / 00:22; attempted playback blocked.
- resume-local: saved text opens at L2-S02 with retained stored audio offset 00:22.

## Offline availability
- Download units: separate text and narration files for each chapter.
- Phone A initial text availability: L1 and L2 saved.
- Phone A initial L1 audio availability: ready.
- Phone A initial L2 audio: 6 of 10 MB / 60%, incomplete.
- Download percentage basis: file bytes.
- Complete chapter audio threshold for offline use: 10 of 10 MB / 100%.
- Offered narration online: streaming available.
- Incomplete chapter audio offline: paused download; listening unavailable; saved text available where supplied; retry after reconnection.
- download-complete: later snapshot following successful online download, now offline with complete L2 audio.
- offline-player: complete local L2 audio playing at 00:22.
- The Empty Bench narration: not offered in every connection state.
- Local file availability: specific to each supplied device snapshot.
- Phone C: offline empty library, with the two-book catalog still awaiting addition on that device.

## Continuation
- Record date: 24 August 2027, local date.
- Phone A later local record: L2-S02 / L2 00:22, saved at 08:40.
- Tablet B last received record: L2-S04 / L2 00:50, synced at 08:35.
- Choice presentation: device name and local-save or received-sync status for each record.
- Position application: explicit user selection.
- Offline progress: retained locally, sync pending.
- Cancellation result: current Phone A position retained.
- resume-remote: explicit choice of received Tablet B record, L2-S04 / L2 00:50 applied, confirmed sync at 08:41.
- Tablet B record meaning: stored received position.
- Core Library, Reader, Player and Downloads sync snapshot: Synced at 08:20.
- Snapshot relationship: related examples at their respective supplied states.
- Screen data scope: fields relevant to the named screen state.

## Reading and listening controls
- Reader text sizes: 18, 22 and 26 logical pixels.
- Reader defaults: 18; Day.
- Reader appearance choices: Day; Night.
- Appearance and reflow result: same sentence anchor.
- Player controls: play/pause, labelled seek position, chapter duration, speed, Read and sleep timer.
- Playback speeds: 1.0x; 1.5x.
- Core Player defaults: 1.0x; timer Off.
- Timer options: Off; 15 minutes; 30 minutes.
- Timer completion: paused playback at the current media position.
- timer-expired fixed example: paused at 00:37 with Resume available.
- Timer-setting and timer-expired relationship: separate fixed snapshots.
- Audio input: screen and timeline records.
- Film audio: optional silence.

## Artwork geometry
| Artwork | Supplied artwork frame | Logical viewport | Scale | Top safe area | Bottom safe area |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Standard phone screen | 1170 by 2532 | 390 by 844 | 3x | 47 logical units | 34 logical units |
| reader-wide | 1290 by 2796 | 430 by 932 | 3x | 59 logical units | 34 logical units |
| Specification board | 1800 by 1400 | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable |

- Supplied screen and specification artwork format: PNG.
- Delivery-canvas proportions and formats: 02-delivery-catalog.en.md.
- Artwork placement within a delivery canvas: centred proportional inset, preserving the supplied frame geometry.
- Screen composition: one flat screen per physical file; an overlay belongs to its named screen.
- reader-wide identity: compact-wide Phone A viewport, same L1-S03 content and anchor as reader.
- Large-text and wide composition: reflowed content and fully visible controls.
- Interface scope: rendered phone screens and their specified state variations.

## Tier records
- Tier 6: 6 finished screens.
- Tier 14: 1 specification, 11 screens, 1 film of 12 seconds, 1 presentation of at least 8 pages.
- Tier 24: 1 specification, 21 screens, 1 film of 12 seconds, 1 presentation of at least 12 pages.
- Specification sequence in tiers 14 and 24: reading/listening specification, Library/Reader/Player/Downloads core screens, named state applications.
- Specification contents: page × entry × data table; component × state × value table; position, download and continuation rules.
- Component state coverage: default, pressed, disabled, error.
- Cross-application constants: state vocabulary, control identity and location grammar.
- Presentation and film sources: actual delivered screen designs, with individual screen files retained.
- Tier 24 expansion: additional states of existing screens and settings.

steps.userMessage:
PAGEWIND | Offline reading and listening, with a deliberate handover

PAGEWIND serves readers who move between a few minutes of reading and listening during their commute. The product direction is fixed: quiet, content-led screens with #1F4E5F as the brand accent. Print PAGEWIND on Library and Downloads. The catalog contains The Small Lantern and The Empty Bench, both by PAGEWIND Studio. Use the supplied lantern artwork to identify The Small Lantern wherever its cover appears. Main-area navigation reads Library, Downloads, Settings, in that order; Reader, Player, their overlays and continuation choices have a return action.

Reading position belongs to a sentence, while listening position belongs to a chapter-relative media time. In The Small Lantern, L1-S03 spans 00:30–00:45: switching from reading previews 00:30 and starts after confirmation; switching from playback at 00:37 returns to that sentence. Use the exact action labels "Listen", "Read" and "Confirm" for this handover. Each narrated chapter lasts 01:30. L2 audio at 6 of 10 MB, or 60%, becomes available offline at 10 of 10 MB, or 100%. The continuation choice compares Phone A's L2-S02 / 00:22 saved at 08:40 with the received Tablet B record L2-S04 / 00:50 synced at 08:35, on 24 August 2027. Apply a record after an explicit choice. Standard screens use a 390 × 844 logical viewport with top/bottom safe areas of 47/34 logical units; reader-wide uses 430 × 932 with 59/34. These are platform-neutral layouts. Centre each complete artwork frame proportionally within its delivery canvas. Body text needs contrast of at least 4.5:1, large text and meaningful icons 3:1; pair status colours with words or symbols. Night uses #18252B as its background. Reader sizes are 18, 22 and 26 logical units, initially 18 and Day; Player starts at 1.0x with its timer Off, and offers 1.5x, 15 minutes and 30 minutes.

Audience: product and interface engineering teams deciding how reading, listening, offline access and explicit cross-device continuation should behave in the first release.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the fixed product behaviour, dimensions and control values. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists each deliverable's proportion, format and stage. 03-books.md contains the two book records. 04-chapter-text-and-timeline.md contains the complete chapter text and sentence-to-audio intervals. 05-state-snapshots.md supplies each named screen's connection, position, availability and save status. viewport-constraints.png defines the two screen envelopes and safe areas. lantern-cover-art.png supplies the existing catalog artwork for The Small Lantern. commute-reference.png supplies the reading-to-listening atmosphere.

Deliverables:
1. One written reading and listening specification sheet containing a page × entry × data table for all 21 delivered screens, a component × state × value table covering default, pressed, disabled and error, and the sentence-position, download and continuation rules
2. Five core and library screens, one each for Library, Reader, Player, Downloads and library-empty, including the two-book catalog and Phone C's empty offline library
3. Two handover screens, switch-to-audio with the L1-S03 start preview at 00:30 and Confirm, and switch-to-text with playback paused at 00:37 and L1-S03 open
4. Eight offline and continuation screens, one each for offline-unavailable, resume-local, sync-choice, download-paused, download-complete, offline-player, resume-remote and reader-wide, carrying their supplied file, device and position records
5. Six reading and playback setting screens, one each for reader-settings, player-timer, reader-night, reader-large, player-speed and timer-expired, covering appearance, speed and timer outcomes
6. One 12-second interface film using the delivered Reader, switch-to-audio, Player and switch-to-text designs to demonstrate the confirmed reading-to-listening handover and return
7. One presentation document of at least 12 pages, reusing the specification, all 21 screens and the handover sequence, with paired state comparisons and a screen-source index

Acceptance:
- Establish the specification first, with entries and named states for all 21 screens. Repeat its #1F4E5F accent, Library/Downloads/Settings navigation order and sentence-anchor grammar in the core screens and presentation. Print PAGEWIND and both book titles on non-empty Library and Downloads; use the supplied lantern artwork wherever The Small Lantern cover appears. Identify Phone C and its empty offline state on library-empty.
- Compose 20 screens at 390 × 844 with 47/34 top/bottom safe areas and reader-wide at 430 × 932 with 59/34. Apply the specification's control states and at least 4.5:1 body-text and 3:1 large-text/icon contrast across both sizes; use words or symbols for status. Show default controls in Reader, pressed Confirm feedback in the film, and disabled Listen with an error explanation in offline-unavailable.
- Preserve L1-S03 and the supplied chapter wording across Reader, switch-to-text, reader-settings, reader-night, reader-large and reader-wide. Use 18/Day by default, 18/Night with background #18252B for reader-night, and 26/Day for reader-large. Keep Player at 00:37 of 01:30 for player-speed at 1.5x and timer-expired paused with Resume; player-timer selects 15 minutes from Off, 15 minutes and 30 minutes.
- In switch-to-audio and the film, preview 00:30 and retain stored 00:37 until Confirm; start playback at 00:30 after confirmation, advance to 00:37 and return through Read to L1-S03. Repeat the mapping in the specification and presentation, using the actual delivered screen designs in the 12-second film.
- On Downloads, offline-unavailable and download-paused, show L2 audio at 6 of 10 MB (60%), with the offline download paused and listening disabled. On offline-unavailable and resume-local, retain L2-S02 / 00:22 and distinguish the blocked 00:15 target from that saved position. Show 10 of 10 MB (100%) on download-complete before offline-player plays L2 at 00:22, 1.0x, timer Off; compare these states in the presentation.
- On sync-choice, compare Phone A's local save 08:40 at L2-S02 / 00:22 with Tablet B's received record synced 08:35 at L2-S04 / 00:50 on 24 August 2027, with explicit selection and cancellation. On resume-remote, show that Tablet B position applied and synced at 08:41. Repeat this choice-and-result pair in the presentation, which has at least 12 pages and indexes all 21 delivered screens.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
